bio: Somewhat tucked away, this delightful restaurant in the Zurich Oberland has plenty of regulars. One of its draws is the wonderful view; in good weather you can see Mount Säntis. The interior is very pleasing – some aspects are cosy and traditional, others rather more modern. In summer, make a beeline for the gorgeous terrace in front of the building. The menu changes with the seasons. Friendly and dedicated front-of-house team....
